en: {fb:5B80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Hey, cut it out. Why are you asking me? I'm no good with that kind of thing!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}So get somebody else to go! Anyway! No scary stuff, please!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What a fishy case. Kinda scary too... Oh well. I'll do it for you!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}If I can't handle at least this much, who knows what people will say. Well, I'll do my best somehow.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Hey... that sounds kinda scary. I'll pass.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}So what! I get to choose too, you know. Anyway, no means no!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hmm, if that's all, it's a piece of cake, but I kinda feel like that thing doesn't really matter.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Anyway, you need it, right? Then I'll go right away. It's a good way to kill time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7980}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I wondered what it was, and that's all? Why do I get asked to run errands like that?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Ask somebody else for stuff like that! I'm not idle either, you know!! Ugh, I shouldn't have even listened!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hmm, sounds like an interesting case. Is this where I come in? Okay. I'll do it for you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Well, this kind of thing is right up my alley.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8380}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hmm... that sounds fun, but it's kinda bad timing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Come back another time. If it's still not solved by then, I'll go for you. Okay!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hmm. So I just have to go there? Sure. That much is easy.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}But that's a weird thing to ask. Well, it sounds fun, so whatever.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8D80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}No way, no way. Why do I have to go all the way out there?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}If it's got nothing to do with the mission, leave me alone. I'm not just sitting around, y'know!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I've received a report that a dangerous criminal has fled into the Esparda Empire.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}As a hero, I'd really like you to deal with it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah? Then I guess I'll do it, to test my skills.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Long story short, I just gotta beat 'em, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}That's right. Can I ask you?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}...Can't wait to see what kind of guys they are. Leave it to me!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I see. I get it. But if only I'd heard sooner...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Sorry. Something else came up... Something I really can't skip.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}In Esparda, a mysterious fiend leading monsters has been attacking villagers.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}The fiend seems highly skilled in martial arts, and the villagers are suffering terribly.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Got it. I'll do it. The villagers can't go on like this.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I haven't fought anybody worth it lately. Perfect timing. I'll beat that guy.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Guys like that, the knights can handle 'em without me, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Besides, I'm busy too. Sorry, but could you try somebody else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}They say a fiend who uses martial arts has appeared in Kanoa.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I'd like you to deal with this fiend.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}They say a fiend who uses martial arts has appeared in Kanoa.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I'd like you to deal with this fiend.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Beasia, about the fiend who uses martial arts...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah, I know him. A weird one.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}He's appeared again and is attacking people. Beasia, please go and deal with them.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah, a gutless fiend like that's no sweat. This time I'm gonna beat him for sure.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Beasia, about the fiend who uses martial arts...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Him again? But let me think about it a bit.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Something's bugging me. I've got a bad feeling.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}That fiend who uses martial arts has appeared.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Will you go and defeat him?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}That fiend who uses martial arts has appeared.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Would you kindly go and defeat him?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Him, huh... He's finally shown up...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, of course! I'm the one who's gotta beat him.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm gonna settle... everything...!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...Sorry, not yet. Can you let me train a bit more?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I feel like I don't have the strength to stand up to him yet. I think I'm almost there, so please.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Point is, I just gotta beat the stuffing outta that guy, right? Piece of cake.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}The stronger they are, the better the training. Just leave it to me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Sorry, but... I don't think I can take that mission. Something else came up.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'd really love to take it, but this time... could you try somebody else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0B80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Sorry, but... I don't think I can take that mission. Something else came up.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'd really love to take it, but this time... could you try somebody else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Fine by me. Guys like that only learn the hard way anyway.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}For me, it's a good way to blow off some steam.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I'll pass. It doesn't have to be me for guys like that, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}They're just no challenge. So sorry, but try somebody else.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hmm, I see. Point is, I just gotta knock that guy flat? Then I'll take it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I'll wrap it up easy. It's nothing much anyway, right? It's written all over your face.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1F80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...And you want me for this job? Sorry, but I'm passing on this one.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Actually, there's somewhere I really have to go. Make it another time, okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Bandit hunting, huh... Got it. I'll do it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I was just looking for a sparring partner. Perfect for some real-fight practice.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3380}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Sheesh... you came all this way for that? Sorry, but spare me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}It'd feel like picking on the weak, so I'm not into it. Bring me somebody with more bite.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sounds like a nasty one... But whatever. I'll give it a shot.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Well, it's all part of training. Now I just gotta trust my own skills.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3D80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Sounds like a nasty one... Sorry, but... I'll skip it this time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm just not feeling it. Guys who use magic just aren't my thing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sounds like things are getting bad. Sure. I'll do it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}That's the kind of thing I hate most too. I'll wrap it up in one go.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I get the situation, but... this time's a bit much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Even if I went now, I doubt I'd make it in time. Ask somebody closer.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}So I just gotta solve it, right? Well, I'll see what I can do.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Still, what a weird case. Well, I don't think it's anything much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5B80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I wondered what it was about... Sorry, but I'll pass this time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Another hero'll be fine without me, right? Besides, it's nothing much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Weird case. Well... I guess I could go.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Y'know, I'm no good with cases where you gotta use your head. They get on my nerves. Well, it's mental training, at least.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Sorry, but I'll pass this time. I'm no good with that kind of thing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Isn't there somebody better at this than me? Sorry, but try somebody else.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Weird case. Well... I guess I could go.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Y'know, I'm no good with cases where you gotta use your head. They get on my nerves. Well, it's mental training, at least.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, if it's your request, I can't really say no.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I'm not that into it, but sure, I'll go.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7980}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I get what you're saying, but why does it have to be me? I'll pass on that.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Ask somebody else for stuff like that. I'm not idle either, y'know.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:8280}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Weird story. ...Well, I'll give it a try. Could be a tougher guy than it looks.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8380}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Weird request. Wasn't there anything better? I can't get fired up for that.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Sorry, but try somebody else.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hmm. I just go there, huh? I ain't got nothin' to do, so sure.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Still, with jobs like this, I'm bored outta my skull.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8D80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I get it, but is there somethin' over there? Walkin' around for no reason's just a pain.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Besides, I'm busy right now. Sorry, but some other time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Winged monsters have appeared in Kanoa and are attacking people. I'd really like you to deal with them.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Winged monsters have appeared in Kanoa and are attacking people. I'd really like you to deal with them, if you would.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}All right. I was just getting bored, so I'll take on the monster hunt.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6F80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Let's see... I don't think I can make it. Sorry, but could you try someone else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}If there's really no one, you can come back again.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Um... I have a request about the winged ones in the Borsa Forest...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...It's been a while, {name:0080}. What's the matter...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Nasadia, Rasuel isn't a fallen angel after all.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
